shell.disclaimer: Educational project. No real payments are processed — never enter a real card number.

notFound.title: Payment link not found
notFound.text: This payment link is not valid.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: We could not load this payment. Please try again.

card.title: Pay by card
card.saveNotice: Your card will be saved for future payments with {{merchant}}.
card.testCard: Test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date, any CVC.
card.failed: We could not process your payment. Please try again.

wallet.title: Pay with a wallet
wallet.intro: Pay with a card you keep in your phone, without typing the number.
wallet.disclaimer: A pretend wallet for trying things out. It is not Apple or Google, and no real card is involved.
wallet.unavailable: The wallet is not available right now.
wallet.confirm: Confirm with Face ID or PIN

blik.title: Pay with BLIK
blik.codeHint: Open your banking app and generate a BLIK code.
blik.codeRequired: Enter the six digit code from your banking app
blik.codeInvalid: That code is not valid or has expired. Generate a new one in your app.

waiting.title: Confirm in your banking app
waiting.text: We sent a request to your bank. Open your banking app and approve the payment. This page updates by itself.
waiting.tryIt: Trying it out? <appLink>Open the pretend bank app</appLink> to approve or reject it. If you do nothing, it is approved after a few seconds.

threeDs.title: Confirm with your bank
threeDs.text: Your bank needs to verify this payment. Enter the one-time code 1234.
threeDs.unreachable: We could not reach your bank. Please try again.

held.title: Payment authorised
held.text: {{amount}} is reserved on your card. {{merchant}} will take the payment later; you may see it as pending.

processing.title: Processing your payment
processing.text: This can take a few seconds. Please do not close this page.

canceled.title: Payment canceled
canceled.text: This payment was canceled by the merchant. You have not been charged.

failed.title: Payment failed
failed.text: Your payment could not be completed.
failed.note: You have not been charged. Ask the merchant for a new payment link to try again.

bnpl.title: Pay in instalments
bnpl.unreachable: {{names}} can not be reached right now.

best.title: Best option
best.text: We pick the provider most likely to say yes, at a good price.

bnpl.fallback: If the first provider cannot help, try the next best ones
bnpl.footnote: The provider decides. {{merchant}} is paid when it approves you.

errors.nationalId: Enter your ID number (6 to 16 letters or digits)

bnpl.applyFailed: We could not send your application. Please try again.
